import codecs
for name in ["cp037","cp1006","cp1026","cp1125","cp1140","cp1250","cp1251","cp1252","cp1253","cp1254","cp1255","cp1256","cp1257","cp1258","cp273","cp424","cp437","cp500","cp720","cp737","cp775","cp850","cp852","cp855","cp856","cp857","cp858","cp860","cp861","cp862","cp863","cp864","cp865","cp866","cp869","cp874","cp875","hp_roman8","iso8859_10","iso8859_11","iso8859_13","iso8859_14","iso8859_15","iso8859_16","iso8859_2","iso8859_3","iso8859_4","iso8859_5","iso8859_6","iso8859_7","iso8859_8","iso8859_9","koi8_r","koi8_t","koi8_u","kz1048","mac_arabic","mac_croatian","mac_cyrillic","mac_farsi","mac_greek","mac_iceland","mac_latin2","mac_roman","mac_romanian","mac_turkish","palmos","ptcp154","tis_620"]:
    encoded = codecs.encode('ABC', name)
    print(name, encoded, codecs.decode(encoded, name))
def recover(error):
    print(type(error).__name__, error.start, error.end)
    return ('?', -1)
codecs.register_error('audit-resume', recover)
print(codecs.encode('\ud800A', 'cp1252', 'audit-resume'))
print(codecs.decode(b'\x81A', 'cp1252', 'audit-resume'))
print(codecs.encode('\udc81A', 'cp1252', 'surrogateescape'))
print(codecs.decode(b'\x81A', 'cp1252', 'surrogateescape').encode('unicode_escape'))
